location: Wyoming State Capitol W113 200 West 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to continue discussions concerning fraud protection and consider bill drafts and amendments for the Joint Corporation Committee's consideration during their next meeting, October 15-16, 2026 in Casper. There is no structured agenda for this working group. The meeting will be held primarily on Zoom, with no livestreaming. Public comment and participation is available in W113 of the Wyoming State Capitol. If you are interested in participating, please email heather.hunter@wyoleg.gov and katie.talbott@wyoleg.gov.
